sources.observed: Sound Effects is a master toggle that clears/restores Background Music; Background Music sends its own toggle without unmuting master.
MH5 red/black button glows start at alpha1 and decrease with black-card alpha, step0.04 per ticker callback; red card is1−black.

implementation: Existing SoundEngine master and background controls retained; no new effects-only routing. MP3 bytes and gain metadata unchanged. Existing legacy consent key is retained; background music preference persists separately. MH5 half-cycle normalized to416.7ms at60Hz; Foxy back remains static.
rights: Publicly delivered provider references preserve their existing provenance; no new licence or authorization claim is made.
